'''Ord Dycoll''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Ord Dycoll system/Legends|Ord Dycoll system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was destroyed by an ancient [[Drill ship (mining starship)|drill ship]] at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]].

==History==
Ord Dycoll was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] sometime before the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet had an Imperial base on its surface. When a massive, ancient mining vessel appeared in orbit of Ord Dycoll, the base attempted to hail it, to no avail. A team was sent up from the base in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to investigate the ship and accidentally triggered its drill appendage to burrow into the planet. Upon reaching its core, the ship caused Ord Dycoll to collapse. Some residents managed to survive the cataclysm in a transport vessel, but had to be picked up by investigators later on when the ship ran out of power. After the devastation, the remains of the world left behind formed an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]].
